text:
Amanda: FYI — Lyra-13B-8k weights just landed in S3 and the runtime probe on the CUDA/Triton matrix is failing. Can we do a quick pass on readiness?

Leo: Path? I'll try local repro on a node.

Amanda: s3://redwood-models/lyra/13b-8k/v1/ (sharded .pth + .index). tokenizer.json attached in the bundle.

Jorge: I kicked the container-rebuild job for cuda:12.4 + triton:2.1 (job #4521). CI started but kernel-probe step errored out.

DevOps CI: job 4521 logs: 
```
[14:22:31] runtime: kernel_select failed: no compatible kernel for sm_86 with fc_flags=INT8_QKV
[14:22:31] runtime: falling back to cpu path (degraded perf)
[14:22:31] triton: failed to load custom ops: cublasLt unsupported for current driver/cuBLAS version
```

Priya: That's the classic cuBLASLt/CUDA mismatch. Lyra uses fused QKV int8 kernels that need cuBLASLt >= 24.x + driver matching CUDA 12.4. Are we on a GPU image that includes cuBLASLt 24?

Jorge: Base image was `nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-devel-ubuntu22.04`. Driver on the nodes is 535.x — looks OK. But our kernel build step only produced kernels for sm_75 and sm_80 in the current container. Lyra's optimized kernels require sm_86 and sm_90 artifacts.

Leo: On my local repro I saw this during `runtime/kernel_probe.py` when it queries `cublasLtGetVersion` and then tries to find prebuilt kernels: it looked for `kernels_sm_86.so` and didn't find it.

Priya: Two immediate options: (1) rebuild the kernel artifacts for sm_86+sm_90 in the container build (preferred), or (2) force the runtime to fall back to generic CUDA kernels (performance hit). I vote rebuild.

Amanda: Agree. Rebuild is fine but let's keep an interim fallback for the hosted fleet so customers aren't impacted. Also noticed tokenizer has a nonstandard bos token id — tests showed shifted decoding in our eval harness.

Leo: Tokenizer quirk: tokenizer.json has "bos_token_id": 2 and "eos_token_id": 1 (reversed). That explains the shift. We should update model_card to normalize to `bos:1,eos:2` unless this mapping is intentional. Who owns model card edits?

Amanda: I'll own model card edits. I'll add a note to override tokenizer config on serve if we can't change upstream weights. Patch will be: 
```
model_card.override_tokenizer = {"bos_token_id": 1, "eos_token_id": 2}
```

Jorge: Rebuild plan: 1) add kernel targets sm_86 & sm_90 to build_kernels.sh; 2) pin cuBLASLt in the container to 24.3.0; 3) bump triton to 2.1.4 and run kernel smoke tests. I'm queuing a rebuild now (job 4529).

DevOps CI: queued job 4529 — container build + kernel compile. ETA ~25m.

Priya: For the runtime change I propose a small guard in kernel selector: if no prebuilt kernels found, emit a clear metric `kernel_missing_for_model` and explicitly enable `REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL` env var for canary routes to test the new bins. Patch snippet: 
```
if not kernels_for(sm_arch):
    metrics.increment('kernel_missing_for_model', model='lyra-13b')
    os.environ.setdefault('REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL', 'sm_86')
```

Leo: Also adding a quick lint to model onboarding to validate tokenizer ids and presence of `.index` file. Example check: `sha256(index) != ''` and `bos != eos`.

Amanda: Sounds good. I'll update the onboarding checklist PR now and include the tokenizer override and a note about required kernel targets.

Jorge: Job 4529 finished — container image pushed: `redwood/rt-lyra:cuda12.4-triton2.1-sm86-sm90-20260316`. Kernel smoke tests passed on sm_86 and sm_90.

DevOps CI: probe suite results: 10/10 probes OK, perf baseline within 5% of target.

Priya: I ran the eval harness with the tokenizer override — decoding now matches expectations. Will merge tokenizer fix to model card after Amanda's doc patch.

Amanda: Merged model card update + onboarding checklist in PR #3784. Rolling canary to 3 nodes with the new image and tokenizer override.

Leo: Canary logs look clean. No CPU fallbacks observed. Latency on p50/p90 stable.

Amanda: Great. Next steps: Jorge, please coordinate capacity resize for Dedicated hosts running Lyra. Priya, follow up to add the kernel targets to the auto-onboard script. I'll close the onboarding ticket after two full days of canary run.

Jorge: On it.

Priya: I'll open a follow-up PR for auto-onboard kernel matrix.

Amanda: Thanks everyone :raised_hands: If anything breaks ping here or @channel for urgent regressions.
